canvas_whoami.name: canvas_whoami
canvas_whoami.description: Confirm Canvas auth and return self profile.

canvas_get_course.name: canvas_get_course
canvas_get_course.description: Get one course including syllabus body when available.

canvas_list_assignments.name: canvas_list_assignments
canvas_list_assignments.description: List assignments for a course. Default detail=compact (no description bodies). Use detail=full or canvas_assignment_brief for prompts.

canvas_get_assignment.name: canvas_get_assignment
canvas_get_assignment.description: Get one assignment with cleaned prompt text.

canvas_assignment_brief.name: canvas_assignment_brief
canvas_assignment_brief.description: Digested assignment brief: prompt, due date, submission types, and supplied rubric with grading/display settings. Missing rubric data stays unknown; inspect rubric_warnings for omitted malformed data.

canvas_list_announcements.name: canvas_list_announcements
canvas_list_announcements.description: List announcements (compact message_text by default). Pass detail=full for full bodies.

canvas_list_modules.name: canvas_list_modules
canvas_list_modules.description: List modules with items (compact item fields by default). Pass detail=full for raw Canvas payloads.

canvas_module_progress.name: canvas_module_progress
canvas_module_progress.description: Read Canvas-declared module progress and completed/unfinished/unknown requirements. Optional module_id selects one returned module. Counts cover returned rows only; missing student fields stay unknown. Does not mark items read or complete.

canvas_list_pages.name: canvas_list_pages
canvas_list_pages.description: List wiki pages for a course.

canvas_get_page.name: canvas_get_page
canvas_get_page.description: Get a wiki page body by URL slug.

canvas_list_discussion_topics.name: canvas_list_discussion_topics
canvas_list_discussion_topics.description: List discussion topics for a course.

canvas_post_discussion_reply.name: canvas_post_discussion_reply
canvas_post_discussion_reply.description: Post a reply to a discussion topic.

canvas_browse_files.name: canvas_browse_files
canvas_browse_files.description: Browse metadata in one Canvas course folder. Start with folder_id=root, then choose a returned child folder ID. Requests one bounded folder page and one file page; no downloads or recursive inventory. has_more is unknown; next_page_to_try is an optional probe, not a confirmed next page.

canvas_list_quizzes.name: canvas_list_quizzes
canvas_list_quizzes.description: List classic quizzes in a course.

canvas_list_quiz_questions.name: canvas_list_quiz_questions
canvas_list_quiz_questions.description: List questions for a classic quiz (when API allows).

canvas_list_quiz_submissions.name: canvas_list_quiz_submissions
canvas_list_quiz_submissions.description: List quiz submissions for a classic quiz.

canvas_start_quiz_submission.name: canvas_start_quiz_submission
canvas_start_quiz_submission.description: Start a classic quiz submission (optional access_code).

canvas_list_conversations.name: canvas_list_conversations
canvas_list_conversations.description: List your Canvas conversations without changing their state. Default inbox includes read and unread non-archived conversations; other scopes are unread, starred, archived, and sent.

canvas_get_conversation.name: canvas_get_conversation
canvas_get_conversation.description: Read one of your Canvas conversations by positive decimal ID, preserving unread state. Returns supplied messages, participants and attachment metadata; does not download links.

canvas_list_calendar_events.name: canvas_list_calendar_events
canvas_list_calendar_events.description: List calendar events (optional ISO start/end dates).

canvas_list_todo_items.name: canvas_list_todo_items
canvas_list_todo_items.description: To-do items for the current user.

canvas_sync_summary.name: canvas_sync_summary
canvas_sync_summary.description: Read upcoming assignments ordered by deadline across courses, with selection counts and per-course read errors.

canvas_submission_feedback.name: canvas_submission_feedback
canvas_submission_feedback.description: Read self submission comments and rubric feedback with original authors, criteria, and grade/attempt metadata. A false grade_matches_current_submission means grading preceded the latest resubmission. Does not calculate a grade.

canvas_api_request.name: canvas_api_request
canvas_api_request.description: Full Canvas REST escape hatch. method=GET|POST|PUT|DELETE|PATCH; path must start with /api/v1 (e.g. /api/v1/users/self). params_json / body_json / form_json are optional JSON objects. Use curated canvas_* tools when they exist; this covers everything else.

canvas_api_paginated.name: canvas_api_paginated
canvas_api_paginated.description: Paginated GET escape hatch for /api/v1 list endpoints. path must start with /api/v1; params_json optional JSON object.
